scope: Read-only official-source review; no GPU jobs or environment modifications. Commits fetched from current upstream refs.

strict_target.layout: logical MHA BHND; pretransposed V storage allowed

entries.name: OpenAI Triton
reason: FP8 branch selects float8_e5m2 / tl.float8e5, not e4m3fn
o=torch.empty_like(q), store casts to FP8, not FP16 output
A single N_CTX and descriptor shape are used for Q/K/V; no independent rectangular Q/KV decode or MTP path
causal supports square upper-left triangle, not general lower-right rectangular mask
entries.autotuning: Official triton.autotune; configs over BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N, stages, warps and hardware pruning; not run locally

entries.name: Tri-Dao Triton
reason: Explicit q.dtype in [torch.float16, torch.bfloat16] assertion
Official AMD Triton backend FP8 via aiter is ROCm-targeted, not GH200
entries.autotuning: No FP8 configuration can pass the official dtype gate

entries.name: Tri-Dao FA3
reason: Hopper FP8 forward exists, but implementation is CUDA/CUTLASS rather than Triton/DSL compiler baseline
Benchmark triton_fused_attention import is optional and that module is not present in this pinned repo tree

entries.name: Tri-Dao FA4 CuTeDSL
reason: Official FP8 guard asserts arch // 10 == 10 (SM100); GH200 is SM90
FP8 output dtype fixed to bfloat16, not target float16
entries.autotuning: Not runnable as FP8 on GH200 under official architecture guard

entries.name: Helion FP8 example
entries.hopper_supported: FP8 transposed-V code path; not GPU-tested in this audit
reason: Correct e4m3fn Q/K/V and probability FP8, FP32 dot/accumulation, pretransposed V
Output explicitly allocated and cast float8_e4m3fn, not FP16
One seq_len reused for Q/K/V; no causal mask or distinct Q/KV lengths
entries.autotuning: @helion.kernel(static_shapes=True) normal tuning; no official FP8 H100/B200 tuned bundle identified

entries.name: Helion tuned attention bundle
reason: Current official README declares only float16 and bfloat16
The existence of an out parameter does not establish supported FP8 input or tuned FP8 schedules
Causal kernel uses q_index>=k_index (upper-left); lacks lower-right rectangular argument
entries.autotuning: Shipped H100/B200 schedules cover documented FP16/BF16 use; no FP8 validation claimed

entries.name: Helion flex example
entries.fp8_official: No explicit FP8 public contract found in checked source
reason: Can use official BlockMask and rectangular shapes
Output allocation is empty_like(query) or dtype=query.dtype; with FP8 Q it returns FP8 rather than FP16
Do not patch official kernel or append output cast and claim equal FP16-output precision
entries.autotuning: Official Helion tuning; no supported equivalent FP8 output configuration identified

entries.name: Helion paged attention
entries.hopper_supported: Existing historical example not current-main kernel
reason: Current official vLLM tree includes Helion FP8 quantization operators, but no Helion attention operator
Prior portable-paged-attention implementation linked by PyTorch blog was closed/unmerged experimental vLLM PR27293; do not label it a new tuned official FP8 attention baseline
entries.autotuning: No current-main Helion FP8 attention configuration to tune

entries.name: vLLM Triton unified attention (optional)
entries.hopper_supported: Triton GPU implementation; not GPU-tested in this audit
reason: Current official source supports FP8 Q as well as FP8 KV and caller-provided output dtype, with rectangular/paged causal attention
It is inaccurate to dismiss all current official vLLM FP8 attention as BF16-Q-only
Uses P*256 cast e4m3 then divided by256 after dot; Q/K/V descales may be set to1 but probability quantization scheme remains different
Paged layout must be prepared outside timing; needs numerical/accuracy validation and explicit inclusion policy rather than silent replacement of requested strict contract
entries.autotuning: Official heuristic launch parameters, optional caller tuning parameters; not independently tuned here

entries.name: TVM
entries.fp8_official: No matching attention example identified in current inspected tree
entries.hopper_supported: Generic compiler, but no audited matching FP8 attention
reason: Relax attention type inference returns Q dtype, so FP8 Q implies FP8 output in that op
Official contrib CuDNN SDPA runner asserts float16 only
Official FP8 CUTLASS files found are GEMM implementations, not matching FP8 attention
FlashInfer extern and CUDA/CUTLASS delegates must not be represented as an independently authored TVM attention compiler kernel
entries.autotuning: No matching official FP8 attention schedule/configuration identified

entries.name: TAWA
entries.hopper_supported: Local implementation exists, but does not meet official-source requirement
reason: This workspace documents TAWA runners as local custom kernels with no standalone package release
GitHub official repository could not be established from source metadata and current repository searches
Do not reuse local historical FP8 code and describe it as independently verified upstream official code
entries.autotuning: Local configurable search space is not evidence of official repository provenance

optional_followup_candidates: vLLM Triton unified attention with explicit probability-scale policy
preferred_workstream: Root/team are auditing official TileLang/TileOPs and PyTorch FlexAttention separately.
